# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.7 · Mac 3.0.1

An audit release: no new screens, safer sync, backups and updates.

## Safer sync (cloud edition)

- A device first loads the cloud copy before it uploads anything, so a device that was offline or freshly opened can no longer overwrite newer records from another device.
- If two devices still change the same records at the same moment, the other device's version is kept and yours is saved as a recovery backup you can download (instead of one silently replacing the other). Full protection needs the updated server; the published Worker includes it.

## Backups

- Backups now also carry your Today layout, weather city, page order and similar display choices, and restoring can be undone exactly once.
- Restoring a backup in the cloud edition keeps your photo wall.
- Deleting a habit asks once and can be undone, with its full history and position.

## Updates and offline use

- The app no longer reloads by itself in the middle of your work after an update; the new version is used the next time you open or refresh it.
- The offline copy includes all illustrations and sample photos.

## Mac app 3.0.1

- The local window imports and exports photo backups (`.llmedia`) with the native file dialog.
- Connecting Google Calendar from the online window returns to the app.
- Download: `Life Ledger_3.0.1_aarch64.dmg` or `Life-Ledger.app.zip` below (Apple Silicon, unsigned: the first time, **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**).

## For people who host their own cloud

- New `GET /api/version` (behind Access), guarded `npm run deploy:preflight` / `deploy:cloudflare -- --confirm` / `deploy:verify`, and migration `0006_state_revision.sql` (adds one column; existing data untouched). See `docs/cloudflare-release-runbook.md`.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.6` stays available. Migration 0006 only adds a column, so older versions keep working with it.
